crossRefs.note: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.
But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.
For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in…
He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer.
Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.
When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.”
Moreover Yahweh’s hand was against them, to destroy them from the middle of the camp, until they were consumed.

translations.web: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.
translations.bsb: For Your arrows have pierced me deeply, and Your hand has pressed down on me.
translations.kjv: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.
translations.asv: For thine arrows stick fast in me, And thy hand presseth me sore.
